## The teacher nobody could find.



Chapter 1 · 2016

### A great teacher nobody could find

It started in 2016 in Allahabad, now Prayagraj. I was a student of G.N. Singh, a Polity teacher and an outstanding educator. He had the teaching. He did not have the reach, and he could not fix that on his own.

Big coaching institutes had advertising budgets large enough to reach every student in the city, while their faculty was often ordinary. The individual teacher next door could deliver the same result for a fraction of the fee, but almost nobody knew he existed. The difference was never teaching. It was reach. Referral and word of mouth were his entire marketing.


It was not a G.N. Singh problem. It was every good teacher's problem in India, and nobody was building the fix.

— The 2016 observation


Chapter 2 · 2018

### Two friends and a two-page website

In 2018 I founded the first AllCoaching. It was tiny: a two-page website, a directory of Prayagraj's coaching institutes. Each institute got a clean page with its address, phone number, batch timings and a YouTube demo class, and teachers could update it themselves.





Amit Ratan with Mangal Yadav, the friend who built the first AllCoaching with him.


My friend Mangal Yadav and I went to work, institute by institute. Within months we had listed more than 90% of Allahabad's coaching institutes, and educators started receiving leads from students who had found them online.

For the first time, the missing discovery layer existed, in a simple form. It worked.




Chapter 3 · 2018

### The day it all disappeared

Then the developer I had hired stopped working on it. I could not write code. Nobody else could fix it. The site fell apart, and the first AllCoaching ended in 2018 itself, along with every listing Mangal and I had collected.

That failure taught me the most important lesson of my working life: if a teacher's business depends on someone else's developer, it can disappear overnight. It is the reason AllCoaching today is built so an educator never needs one.


AllCoaching v1 ended not because the idea was wrong, but because it depended on one developer to stay alive.

— Amit Ratan


Chapter 4 · 2019–2020

### Back to the teachers

I did not stop. From 2019 I worked directly with individual educators: running their ads, building landing pages, helping them turn enquiries into enrolments. Every one of them taught me the same thing. Their teaching was never the bottleneck. Owning a place online where students could find them, trust them and pay them was.

When COVID sent every class online, I watched good teachers stitch together WhatsApp groups, Google Drive folders, Zoom links and Excel sheets, or pay an agency for an app they could not change. They were online, but they did not own anything.

Chapter 5 · 2021–2026

### Five years, hundreds of failed prototypes

In 2021 I gave everything I had to building AllCoaching properly. I failed hundreds of times. Each prototype taught me something the next had to fix. I did not want to release one more "okay" platform into a market already full of them.

One rule held through every version: an educator must be able to build, brand and run their whole academy alone, in a few clicks, without a developer. Everything that broke in 2018 had to be impossible in 2026.

Chapter 6 · 2026

### Your knowledge deserves its own academy

Today AllCoaching works like Shopify, for coaching. An educator signs up, chooses a plan, uploads a course, connects their own domain and starts selling. Payments, student access, their own app and hosting run on their own. The academy carries the educator's name, logo and colours, not ours.


Sign up→Choose a plan→Upload your course→Connect your domain→Start selling


G.N. Singh did not need a marketing team. He needed a place of his own on the internet that worked without him being a technician. Every teacher like him deserves the same.

That is what I have spent the last ten years working on.
That is what AllCoaching is for.





What ten years taught me



## Three things I believe.



01

### Teachers should own their academy

Your website, your domain, your brand, your students' data. Rent nothing you cannot take with you.

02

### No teacher should need a developer

The 2018 site died because one developer left. Building your academy should take clicks, not code or contracts.

03

### Pricing should be plain and predictable

One yearly plan, a clear platform fee, a 7-day free trial with no card. No surprises in the small print.

## Use this in stories.

Copy this paragraph verbatim or adapt for your style. The factual elements (founding year, location, value proposition) are pre-approved by the AllCoaching team.


AllCoaching is an LMS that Indian educators build themselves. Founded in 2018 in Prayagraj by Amit Ratan, the company lets Indian teachers build their own online academy in a few clicks — drag and drop courses, tests, notes and live classes, then make it their brand with their own domain, logo and Android app (iOS app on Pro), with payments and marketplace discovery on the AllCoaching app, all from one login — with 0% commission on Growth and Pro, so educators keep 100% of every sale (90% on Starter). After five years of focused product development, AllCoaching launched its full platform in 2026 so any educator can build a branded academy themselves and still be found by new students.

— AllCoaching standard boilerplate

Key facts



## 10 things to know.



- Founded: 2018 in Prayagraj (formerly Allahabad), Uttar Pradesh, India.

- Founder & CEO: Amit Ratan. Full profile.

- Category: LMS for educators — a self-serve, white-label academy (own domain, own Android app, with iOS on Pro) with marketplace discovery. Every plan starts with a 7-day free trial.

- Current platform launched: 2026, after five years of product development through hundreds of failed prototypes.

- Revenue model: A 7-day free trial on every plan, with no card to sign up, then three plans: Starter at ₹6,999 a year with a 10% platform fee on paid sales, and Growth (₹7,999 a month) and Pro (₹14,999 a month) with 0% commission, so educators keep 100% of every sale. No launch fee and no sales limit.

- Payout cadence: automatic settlement. No minimum payout threshold.

- Headquarters: Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh, India.

- Languages: English, Hindi, plus regional language support across the marketplace.

- Compliance: Aligned with DPDP Act 2023, IT Rules 2021, Consumer Protection E-Commerce Rules 2020, GST under SAC 999293.

Approved founder quotes



## Quote Amit · use any of these.

Pre-approved founder quotes for editorial use. For custom interviews or longer quotes, email contact@allcoaching.in.


India has 3.5 lakh+ isolated personal teaching apps. The problem was never that educators couldn't go online — it was that students couldn't find them at scale. AllCoaching exists to fix the discovery layer.

— Amit Ratan · On founding thesis



App fatigue is the cumulative tax students pay on their own intent. Every excellent educator in India loses students to this tax every single day, and almost nobody talks about it. We started AllCoaching to make the tax go away.

— Amit Ratan · On app fatigue



An educator should be able to build their own academy as easily as they teach a class — their name on the door, their students inside, and nobody standing between them. AllCoaching lets them do that in a few clicks, and still be found by new students.

— Amit Ratan · 2026 thesis



Most teachers don't have a compliance problem. They have a wrong-platform problem. Choose a platform that handles payments and records properly, and much of that burden moves off your desk on day one.

— Amit Ratan · On educator compliance

Do I need a demo or a sales call to start?No. You can start the 7-day free trial yourself, with no card needed, build your academy and then choose a plan. Talk to us only if you want to.

Where can I see AllCoaching prices?All plans are published on the pricing page. Growth (₹7,999 a month) and Pro (₹14,999 a month) take 0% commission, so you keep 100% of every sale; paid yearly they cost ₹79,990 and ₹1,49,990. Starter is ₹6,999 a year with a 10% fee on sales. There is no launch fee and no sales limit. Prices exclude GST.

I run a large academy. Can we discuss a plan?Yes. If you have many teachers, more than one brand or very high monthly sales, use the Contact us button on this page and we will set up a plan around your academy.

How quickly will you reply?WhatsApp is quickest during working hours, Monday to Saturday, 10am to 7pm IST. Emails get a reply within 24 hours.

I am a student. Who should I contact?For access to a course you bought, contact your educator first, since they manage their own academy. For questions about the AllCoaching app, email contact@allcoaching.in.
